_comment: Claude Code MCP config for the Gaffer factory: the two data-plane MCP servers the agent delivers through. tick.sh renders a runtime copy, substituting __GAFFER_DATA__/dispatch.sqlite/__GAFFER_DATA__/memory.sqlite (runtime DB copies), /opt/gaffer-fixture/dispatch-mcp/bin.js//opt/gaffer-fixture/memory-mcp/bin.js (the built dist bins), and __CLAIM_TOKEN__ (RUNNER-OWNED-BOOKKEEPING: the runner-held delivery claim token, so the agent's token-gated evidence writes resolve it from the server env — the agent never handles the token). The memory server additionally gets GAFFER_FACTORY=1 + fixture-app (the ticket's in-scope repo names) so its DIRECT-APPLY writes (digest / feature) are bound to the ticket's repo scope, fail-closed. Build the workspace first: pnpm -r build.
